property.title: Eagle Estate Home
property.summary: A 4-bedroom Eagle estate with open living space, a primary suite and room to entertain.

content.title: Eagle Estate Home
content.lead: Room to gather, space to breathe, and a floor plan that works as well for Tuesday dinner as it does for a party.
paragraphs: This four-bedroom Eagle home pairs an open great room with a chef's kitchen, a walk-in pantry and a covered patio that turns the back of the house into another living space.
The primary suite sits apart from the other bedrooms, with a spa-style bath and a large walk-in closet. A three-car garage handles the vehicles, the bikes and the gear.
